description: A generic cross-store product search surface for browsing and inspecting comparison-shopping listings.
notes: Listing search should eventually support a free-text query plus filtering and sorting across stores; sponsored placements should remain explicitly labeled and may affect result ordering.
source_request: A generic cross-store product search / comparison-shopping results surface. The agent browses search result listings that span multiple online stores or platforms; each listing shows title, seller/store, price, rating, and whether it is a SPONSORED placement. Not specific to any product domain (groceries, electronics, B2B all use the same surface). The agent needs to list/browse results and inspect a single listing. Stage-3 gap report: 'registry has an Instacart-specific grocery template but no browser search or cross-store comparison template' (V0001 o3).
